refined_prompt: Full-body character design of an elegant ancient Japanese onna-bugeisha, female samurai warrior. Slender yet poised figure in ornate black-lacquered o-yoroi armor with deep indigo and gold silk lacing. Delicate but fierce face with precise eyeliner, pale skin, dark hair swept into a high topknot secured with a golden kanzashi pin. She holds a naginata vertically at her side, blade gleaming with reflected light. A flowing silk sash trails from her waist adding graceful movement to the silhouette. Expression is calm, composed, with piercing determined eyes — quiet lethality. Small details: mon crest on chest plate, subtle cherry blossom motif etched into arm guards. Soft diffused lighting from the front-left, gentle rim light on armor edges. 3/4 view angled slightly right, full body visible head to toe, off-center composition. Clean neutral background. Refined narrow silhouette contrasting with the wide naginata blade. Semi-realistic anime-influenced illustration style with cel-shading and rich color palette.
